{{Vanilla|Nether Quartz}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Quartz''' is a white mineral used for decoration, glass and circuits. It is the vanilla {{MCW|Nether Quartz|nether quartz}}, renamed because in Matcha Flavoured it is mainly an Overworld material: it is mined from quartz deposits and can be made from sand in a blast furnace.

== Obtaining ==
=== Mining ===
Quartz drops from [[Quartz Deposit|quartz deposits]] (vanilla lapis lazuli ore) and [[Sulfurous Quartz Deposit|sulfurous quartz deposits]] (vanilla redstone ore), which generate in the Overworld. See [[Ores]]. [[Sulfurous Hellstone|Sulfurous hellstone]], the old nether quartz ore, drops [[Sulfur Chunk|sulfur chunks]] instead.

=== Cooking and crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
* Blasting [[sand]] in a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]] gives 1 quartz in 5 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/quartz.json}}</ref>
* Any quartz block (block of quartz, quartz bricks, quartz pillar, chiseled quartz block or smooth quartz block) crafts back into 4 quartz.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/quartz_from_quartz_blocks.json}}</ref>
The vanilla recipes that smelt and blast nether quartz ore are removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref> Picking up sand or any quartz block unlocks these recipes.

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
Besides the vanilla uses (quartz blocks, the [[Electric Comparator|electric comparator]], observers and daylight detectors), quartz is used in:
* '''Glass''': a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] fires quartz into [[glass]] (5 seconds).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/kiln/glass_from_smoking_quartz.json}}</ref>
* '''Clocks''': four gold ingots around a quartz, replacing the vanilla recipe's electric wire.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/clock.json}}</ref>
* '''Diorite''': two cobblestone and two quartz make 4 diorite.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/diorite.json}}</ref>
